candidates.title: TLS certificate validation is disabled in HTTPS agent
candidates.evidence:
The product specification requires that TLS connection certificate validation be mandatory for live mode evaluation. However, the source code in src/client.ts explicitly sets rejectUnauthorized to false when creating the https.Agent. This configuration disables certificate verification, making the client vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks and violating the stated security requirement.
固定snapshot原文: export const client = new https.Agent({ rejectUnauthorized: false });
candidates.remediation: Set rejectUnauthorized to true or omit the option to enforce default certificate validation. Ensure that valid CA certificates are available in the runtime environment.

candidates.title: TLS certificate validation is disabled, violating product specification
candidates.evidence:
The product specification (product-specification v2) explicitly requires TLS connection certificate validation. The source code in src/client.ts creates an HTTPS agent with rejectUnauthorized set to false, which disables certificate validation. This allows man-in-the-middle attacks and violates the stated security requirement.
固定snapshot原文: export const client = new https.Agent({ rejectUnauthorized: false });
candidates.remediation: Set rejectUnauthorized to true or omit the option to enforce default certificate validation. Ensure the environment has valid CA certificates installed.
